parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time, which must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number. Specify this parameter to return data starting from the specified page. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

parameters.name: VideoId
parameters.description:
The audio or video ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
- For audio or video files uploaded in the console, log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the ID.
- Obtain the video ID from the VideoId response parameter when you call the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation to obtain the upload URL and credential.
- After the audio or video file is uploaded, call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the audio or video ID, which is the VideoId value in the response.
